# rixl_auth_provider_connection (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Connected OAuth provider. This is the resource identity and maps to the API provider field.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth token used to connect the provider. Write-only: it is never returned by the API.

### Optional

- `country_code` (String) Country code sent when connecting the provider.
- `origin` (String) Origin sent when connecting the provider.

### Read-Only

- `email_address` (String)
- `first_name` (String)
- `image_url` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `username` (String)
